messages.subject: 2PL LLTM
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to perform a 2PL-LLTM+Error term based on the examples provided in the mixedmirt(). However, I am encountering an error, which I am unable to understand. It works if the item type was a Rasch, but not a 2PL model.   I would appreciate some advice on this.

##LLTM with item error term
LLTMwithError <- mixedmirt(dat1, model = model, fixed = ~ 0 + f1 + f2 + f3 + f4 + f5 + f6 + f7, itemtype = '2PL', random = ~ 1|items, itemdesign = itemdesign)

Stage 1 = 199, LL = -3912.1, AR(0.62; 0.00) = [0.52; 0.30], Max-Change = 0.0532Error in nlm(f = fn, p = CTVs[pick]) : non-finite value supplied by 'nlm'
